name: Budget Rollup (Creator × Sprints)
description: Composed pure-JSON artifact: Zoho Creator (account budgets) fans out to Zoho Sprints (logged hours) per account via mcp.mapCall, then data.transform fills logged + utilization. creatorCall(getCreatorRecords) -> mcp.mapCall(GetLogHours per Project_ID) -> compose. One page of logs per account (full totals need mcp.fetchAll); per-bucket logged needs a GetItems join.

parameters.argsExpr: {path_variables: {teamId: '688179193', projectId: Project_ID}, query_params: {action: 'data', listviewtype: `0`, logtypes: '[0]', index: `1`, range: `250`}, headers: {"x-za-ui-version": 'v2', "X-convert-response": 'true'}}

parameters.expression: {accounts: results[].{name: item.Project_Name, projectId: item.Project_ID, total: to_number(item.Total_Budget_Hours), logged: floor(sum((data.data.logs || `[]`)[].to_number(logTime)) / `36000`) / `100`, utilization: floor((sum((data.data.logs || `[]`)[].to_number(logTime)) / `36000`) / to_number(item.Total_Budget_Hours)) / `100`, buckets: [{label: 'Planning / Ops / New Requests', budget: to_number(item.Planning_Ops_New_Requests)}, {label: 'Production Support', budget: to_number(item.Production_Support)}, {label: 'Maintenance / Development', budget: to_number(item.Maintenance_Development)}, {label: 'Deployments / Releases', budget: to_number(item.Deployments_Releases)}, {label: 'Buffer', budget: to_number(item.Buffer1)}]}}
